items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
items.en_title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
items.en_oneliner: Instead of computing pixels, Claude Fable 5.2 writes Python code that paints images with hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes.

items.title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
items.en_title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
items.en_oneliner: Megaspeed reportedly lined up nearly $12 billion worth of Nvidia chip orders for Chinese firms in 2024–2025, and the firm belongs to the former partner of ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
items.en_title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
items.en_oneliner: Australia's central bank has found that since ChatGPT arrived, AI has hit young newcomers in highly exposed jobs first — software development and customer service among them.

items.title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
items.en_title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
items.en_oneliner: The weights of Meituan's LongCat-2.5 are now open: the agent model has 1.6 trillion parameters, was trained wholly on domestic hardware, and scores 88.4 on Terminal Bench.

items.title: datasette-apps 0.4a0
items.en_oneliner: datasette-apps 0.4a0 brings sandboxed HTML and JavaScript apps inside Datasette — like Claude Artifacts, but able to run SQL queries against your data.

items.title: datasette-agent 0.6a0
items.en_oneliner: datasette-agent 0.6a0 is Datasette's agent plugin for asking questions about your data, and this release adds an agent prompt directly in the interface.

items.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.en_oneliner: After Nvidia's security chief quietly departed in August, CEO Jensen Huang has now stepped down over personal relationships — and the piece asks what happened to the company's security safeguards.

items.title: datasette-llm 0.1a11
items.en_oneliner: datasette-llm 0.1a11 is the intermediate Datasette plugin for configuring LLMs, and this release adds support for OpenAI-compatible APIs.

items.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.en_title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.en_oneliner: A petition asking Nvidia to bring Jensen Huang back has drawn signatures from Elon Musk and other tech leaders, passing 115,000 by Saturday afternoon.

items.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.en_title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.en_oneliner: This ever-growing list rounds up AI projects that folded or fell short — from Apple's much-delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's chaotic "super app" launch.

items.title: datasette-vega 0.7
items.en_oneliner: datasette-vega 0.7 revives Datasette's longest-dormant plugin, charting tables or custom query results with Vega-Lite — its previous release dates back to July 2018.
